title: Finite surjective descent of global sections for etale sheaves of sets
statement: Let $f:X'\to X$ be a morphism of schemes which is finite [def-weil-finite-integral-morphism] and surjective [def-weil-surjective-morphism], let $X''=X'\times_XX'$ [def-pc-fibre-product] with projections $p_1,p_2:X''\to X'$, and $f_1=f\circ p_1=f\circ p_2$. Let $G$ be a sheaf of sets on $X_{\Et}$ [def-weil-pbc-etale-sheaf-of-sets], and use the inverse images, the pullbacks $e^*$ of sections and the isomorphisms $c$ of [lem-weil-pbc-sets-etale-inverse-image-composition-units]. Then the map $\Gamma(X,G)\to\Gamma(X',f^{-1}G)$, $s\mapsto f^*s$, is injective, and its image is the set of $s'\in\Gamma(X',f^{-1}G)$ with $c_{f,p_1,G}(p_1^*s')=c_{f,p_2,G}(p_2^*s')$ in $\Gamma(X'',f_1^{-1}G)$. That is, $\Gamma(X,G)$ is the equalizer of $\Gamma(X',f^{-1}G)\rightrightarrows\Gamma(X'',f_1^{-1}G)$.
